newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Bolivia's government seeks to postpone election.
newsitem.headline: Bolivia's government seeks to postpone election.

text.p: The Bolivian government is seeking to postpone by a month general elections scheduled for next June, Guillermo Justiniano, minister of the president's office, said Thursday.
The government wants to delay voting to July 6 to "avoid too large a transition period" between the election and the assumption of power August 6.
The government sent the proposal to Congress.
-- Carlos Alberto Quiroga, La Paz newsroom, 5912 391366
